name: P-002 / R-6 live ship-verdict census before and after the verification-profile backfill (plan-verification-profiles-2026-10-17)
summary: Against the live operator database (papercusp-workspace), every shipped plan's acceptance gate was re-evaluated before and after the one-time harness_plans.verification_profile backfill. The census uses the gate option reevaluateShipped (SHIP_VERDICT_CENSUS_GATE_OPTS), so a shipped plan is evaluated rather than short-circuited to satisfied. Before: 848 shipped plans, 9 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 skipped as already-shipped (the 9 satisfied plans are 7 rubric-template plans and 2 template instances). The backfill then updated 2559 plan rows (executed=true candidates=2559 updated=2559). After: 848 plans, 9 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 skipped as already-shipped. diffShipVerdicts over the two snapshots: compared=848 unchanged=848 changed=0 onlyBefore=0 onlyAfter=0. A second dry run after the backfill found 0 candidates, so the backfill is idempotent on live data.

assertions.evidence: CENSUS_RESULT path=.papercusp/scratch/wi6554/census-before2.json plans=848 satisfied=9 errors=0 skippedAlreadyShipped=0 seconds=299 (exit 0). Committed copy: docs/evidence/plan-verification-profiles-r6-live-census-2026-10-20/census-before.json, takenAt 2026-10-20T05:40:50.588Z, count 848.

CENSUS_RESULT path=.papercusp/scratch/wi6554/census-after2.json plans=848 satisfied=9 errors=0 skippedAlreadyShipped=0 seconds=272 (exit 0). Committed copy: docs/evidence/plan-verification-profiles-r6-live-census-2026-10-20/census-after.json, takenAt 2026-10-20T05:48:19.796Z, count 848.
DIFF_RESULT compared=848 unchanged=848 changed=0 onlyBefore=0 onlyAfter=0 (DIFF_EXIT=0). Re-run 2026-10-20T15:03Z over the same two files: identical DIFF_RESULT, exit 0.
Dry run after the backfill: BACKFILL_RESULT executed=false candidates=0 updated=0 (DRYRUN_AFTER_EXIT=0).

environment.runner: npx tsx from the repository root of the canonical staging checkout

rerun.expect: DIFF_RESULT compared=848 unchanged=848 changed=0 onlyBefore=0 onlyAfter=0
rerun.freshCensus: npx tsx scripts/backfill-plan-verification-profiles.mts --census <out.json> re-measures the live verdicts now; plans shipped after 05:48Z appear as onlyAfter, and gate code changed since then can move verdicts for reasons unrelated to the backfill.

limitations: The census code was committed at 2026-10-20T05:43:08Z in 98d59341a7, and its blobs are unchanged since. The before census ran 05:35-05:41Z from the shared working tree, before that commit; the after census ran after it. Whether the working-tree bytes at 05:35Z equal the committed blobs was not separately recorded.
The census and backfill ran from the working tree through tsx against the live database, not through the :3170 or :3070 operator process.
The census re-evaluates the gate in-process; it records each plan's satisfied flag, top code and blocker list, not the full gate payload.

instrument.role: shipVerdictSnapshot and diffShipVerdicts (verification-profile-backfill.ts) produce each verdict and the comparison. The integration test asserts that the backfill keeps the ship verdict and is idempotent (test_runs 21412963, mutant caught 21413005).
